notes: dockerfile morphology: functions are RUN/CMD/HEALTHCHECK instructions (main 5 = 4 RUN + CMD; HEALTHCHECK is dual func+safety in a); class_start 1 per file = FROM (the stage/base = class construct, tier-1 exception); args = ARG instructions (1 per file); import = FROM (chain main->a->b->c; c FROM scratch is the leaf). ENV is dual globals+state (a state 2). io includes package managers (c io 2 = apt-get + yum, finditer-confirmed). c func 4 = 4 RUN incl the clean: — no. 4 RUN lines. makefile-style api: a api 1 recorded as observed (opaque conversion). Locked 2026-08-31. String decoy redesigned per keyword-rosetta#17 (2026-09-02, wave 2): danger-only "eval" literal in the same module-level RUN export (b.dockerfile has no functions to scope to) — b.dockerfile branch 1->0, io 1->0, state_mutation 4->2. A.4 (gitgalaxy#2669): args/avg_func_args ledgered as intended morphology — RUN/CMD/HEALTHCHECK take no parameters and ARG is a file-scoped build variable, one per file by design; more ARG lines would be overlap-free but consumed by nothing (ledger args-no-parameter-surface-morphology). gitgalaxy#2675: io matched bare package-manager names, so `apt-get clean`/`yum clean all` -- pure local cache cleanup that cleanup owns -- counted as io; now requires a non-clean subcommand and io records the planted 3. api (gitgalaxy#2729): one `EXPOSE <port>` line per file after the ARG line (main 1, a 1, b 1, c 1) -- non-function surface; overlap: listeners +1 and ipc_rpc_bridges +1 per file (both ungated); api_orphan_credit unchanged (a keeps its pre-existing opaque 1); every planted count unchanged. 2026-09-05 (keyword-rosetta#59): safety 1 -> 2 in a.dockerfile -- the 1 was `HEALTHCHECK` counting dual func_start+safety, so the file was one real safety construct short. `USER probe` is that construct, placed before the RUN instructions it applies to so it does not fall inside a preceding slice's body (Mode A runs each instruction to the next func_start match). Ledger batch4-dual-keyword-overlaps. Separately, api_orphan_credit 1 -> 0: gitgalaxy#2754 stopped the `RUN`/`HEALTHCHECK` igniter-keyword buckets entering the orphan check at all, so there are no orphans left to convert -- ledger api-declared-orphans-are-not-new-surface.
